newsitem.title: USA: Gabelli group raises Sequa class B stake.
newsitem.headline: Gabelli group raises Sequa class B stake.

text.p: A group led by New York investment manager Mario Gabelli said Monday it raised its stake in Sequa Corp to 26.38 percent of the company's class B common shares outstanding.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought a net of 33,300 additional class B common shares between June 26 and July 23 at prices ranging from $55 to $62.85 a share.
The Gabelli group said it holds the stake in Sequa for investment purposes.
Sequa is a technology-based company involved in the manufacture and repair of jet engines and the production of solid propellant and rocket motors for missiles.
